stem: A task can be completed only by bypassing a protective device on powered equipment. What should a Technician I learner do?
choices: Stop and escalate because bypassing the safeguard exceeds routine authorized work
Bypass it once if production is behind
Ask a coworker to bypass it instead
Proceed if the equipment has never caused an injury
rationale: Production pressure does not justify bypassing safeguards or exceeding the technician's maintenance authority.
